block.longDescription: Connect to any email server via IMAP protocol to trigger workflows when new emails are received. Supports Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, and any other IMAP-compatible email provider.

subBlocks.title: Search Criteria
subBlocks.description: ImapFlow search criteria as JSON object. Default: unseen messages only.

wandConfig.prompt:
Generate ImapFlow search criteria as a JSON object based on the user's description.

Available properties (all optional, combine as needed):
- "unseen": true - Unread messages
- "seen": true - Read messages
- "flagged": true - Starred/flagged messages
- "answered": true - Replied messages
- "deleted": true - Deleted messages
- "draft": true - Draft messages
- "from": "sender@example.com" - From address contains
- "to": "recipient@example.com" - To address contains
- "cc": "cc@example.com" - CC address contains
- "subject": "keyword" - Subject contains
- "body": "text" - Body contains
- "text": "search" - Headers or body contains
- "since": "2024-01-01" - Emails since date (ISO format)
- "before": "2024-12-31" - Emails before date
- "larger": 10240 - Larger than N bytes
- "smaller": 1048576 - Smaller than N bytes
- "header": { "X-Priority": "1" } - Custom header search
- "or": [{ "from": "a@x.com" }, { "from": "b@x.com" }] - OR conditions
- "not": { "from": "spam@x.com" } - Negate condition

Multiple properties are combined with AND.

Examples:
- Unread from boss: { "unseen": true, "from": "boss@company.com" }
- From Alice or Bob: { "or": [{ "from": "alice@x.com" }, { "from": "bob@x.com" }] }
- Recent with keyword: { "since": "2024-01-01", "subject": "report" }
- Exclude spam: { "unseen": true, "not": { "from": "newsletter@x.com" } }

Current criteria: {context}

Return ONLY valid JSON, no explanations or markdown.
wandConfig.placeholder: Describe what emails you want to filter...

subBlocks.title: Setup Instructions
subBlocks.default:
1. Enter your IMAP server details (host, port, SSL settings)
2. Enter your email credentials (username and password)
3. For Gmail: Use an App Password instead of your regular password
4. Select the mailbox to monitor (INBOX is most common)
5. Optionally configure search criteria and processing options
6. The system will automatically check for new emails and trigger your workflow
